messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the video's camera setup to a full-body shot from a rear three-quarter angle. Change only the camera setup. Preserve the person's appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing scene. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the camera setup and movement described above, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Please select the version from before the first clothing change was made and apply the following edit to that version: Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please change the video's camera setup to a full-body shot from a rear three-quarter angle. Change only the camera setup. Preserve the person's appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing scene. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the camera setup and movement described above, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character stands on a cobblestone street, then bends forward at the waist and twists her torso side to side before returning to an upright stance.","camera":"A static, full-body shot from behind at a slight low angle.","clothing":"She wears a pink off-the-shoulder top with white puffed sleeves, black shorts with a gold floral pattern, and light blue slip-on sneakers.","hair_color":"Bright blue.","hairstyle":"Hair is gathered into two high buns on top of the head.","identity":"A slender female video-game character with light skin, shown from behind.","scene":"An old European-style street with brick and stone buildings, shop signs, a black lamppost, and a cobblestone road."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output is a static full-body rear three-quarter view matching the reference framing, with the character placed slightly left of center on a cobblestone street. The character's clothing, blue hair buns, and general action progression are retained, but the background is now a different street view with a dark shopfront and lamppost rather than the source's red-brick storefronts and distant Union Jack.
arguments.requested_change: Change only the camera to a full-body rear three-quarter shot, using the reference for initial viewing direction, subject placement, and framing, while preserving the character, action, scene, and timing.
uncertain: Whether the action timing and progression were fully preserved despite the changed background and apparent motion differences.
unexpected_changes: The scene/background changed from the source street to a different storefront and street layout.
The character's motion appears less dynamic and more static than the source's walking/turning progression.
The output has visible black letterbox borders.
